name: Dothan
overview: Dothan is identified in Scripture as a district and town in Palestine, notable as the place where Joseph sought his brothers (Genesis 37:17) and where the prophet Elisha was located during a divine confrontation with the Syrian army (2 Kings 6:13-17). The biblical narrative highlights God's sovereign protection, as Elisha’s servant was granted spiritual sight to see the heavenly host surrounding them, even as the Syrian forces besieged the city. This account underscores the truth that God's power surpasses earthly threats, assuring believers of His presence and deliverance in times of danger.
